title: Project-R decompilation registry
description: decomp_registry.json as loaded by pr-builder (src/pr_builder/registry.py, v0.1.0): a `games` map keyed by the ROM's MD5. Fields pr-builder reads are id, name, platform, repo, build_type, build_args, asset_extractor, install_binary, deps and retroarch_fallback; pr-builder ignores every other field, so the provenance fields (rom_name, rom_sha1, source, support_source, build_source, notes) are registry-only. The registry requires every field explicitly even where pr-builder has a default.

games.description: ROM MD5 (32 lowercase hex digits, No-Intro byte order: .z64 big-endian for N64, headerless .sfc for SNES) -> decompilation/recompilation project.

relativePath.description: Relative POSIX path inside the cloned repo: no leading '/', no '\\', no '.' or '..' segments.

platform.description: Platform id as sent on the wire by pr-mediad. pr-builder's `gamecube` alias is not accepted here; use `gc`.

id.description: Build id: pr-builder's build cache dir (~/.cache/pr-builder/<id>), build lock and pr-maestro game_id. Several ROM hashes may share one id only if they describe the identical build.

name.description: Display title; pr-builder uses it as the library directory ~/games/<platform>/<name>/, so it must be a single safe path component.

repo.description: HTTPS git clone URL (pr-builder runs `git clone --depth=1 <repo>`, default branch).

build_type.description: pr-builder build runner: `make` runs `make <build_args>` in the repo root; `cmake` runs `cmake .. <build_args>` in <repo>/build, then `cmake --build . --parallel`.

build_args.description: argv list (no shell): make arguments, or CMake configure arguments.

asset_extractor.description: Repo-relative script that extracts assets from the ROM, or null when the project extracts at runtime / has no separate step. Informational in pr-builder v0.1.0 (not run).

install_binary.description: Built executable, relative to the repo root (for cmake: build/<path inside the build dir>).

deps.description: pacman package names installed with `pacman -S --needed` before building.

retroarch_fallback.description: libretro core (without _libretro.so) used when the native build fails; empty string = platform default.

rom_name.description: Exact ROM file name of this dump in the No-Intro/Redump DAT.

rom_sha1.description: SHA-1 of the same dump (decomp projects usually check SHA-1; lets reviewers cross-check support_source).

source.description: Where the MD5 is published: permalink to the DAT line (No-Intro / Redump / libretro-database).

support_source.description: Permalink to the project's own list/check of supported dumps (hash list, README, hash-check script).

build_source.description: Permalink to the project's Linux build documentation the build fields come from.

notes.description: Free text: ROM placement, extra steps pr-builder cannot express yet, derivations.
